summary: Methods in Computational Neuroscience is an advanced research training course at the Marine Biological Laboratory (MBL) in Woods Hole, Massachusetts, United States. It is open to graduate students, postdocs and faculty, and the class is selected to balance theoretical and experimental backgrounds. The 2027 course runs from 24 July to 21 August 2027, and applications are due by 10 March 2027.
